source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

support.quote: Every Shield Bash, Bull Rush or Force Shield cast near heroes weakens their damage, so engage close and keep casting while you peel.
support.issue: jargon: 'peel' means nothing to a new player
support.rewrite: Every Shield Bash, Bull Rush or Force Shield cast near heroes weakens their damage, so engage close and keep casting while you protect your carry.

offlane.quote: Bonus armor while healthy, then a shield when low, suits diving in with Riplash. Frost Snap rewards hitting targets suppressed by Skewer.
offlane.issue: misdescribes Riplash: it pulls the enemy to Riktor, it is not a dive
offlane.rewrite: Bonus armor while healthy, then a shield when low, helps you brawl after Riplash pulls a target in. Frost Snap rewards hitting targets suppressed by Skewer.

carry.quote: More health lets you dive with Riplash and survive; Wanton Warden then heals back part of what you take.
carry.issue: misdescribes Riplash: it pulls the enemy to Riktor, it is not a dive
carry.rewrite: More health lets you walk up to land Riplash and survive the fight it starts; Wanton Warden then heals back part of what you take.

carry.quote: Bonus armor while healthy and a shield when low suit diving with Riplash. Frost Snap rewards hitting targets suppressed by Skewer.
carry.issue: misdescribes Riplash: it pulls the enemy to Riktor, it is not a dive
carry.rewrite: Bonus armor while healthy and a shield when low help you brawl after Riplash pulls a target in. Frost Snap rewards hitting targets suppressed by Skewer.

carry.quote: Argus wins with ability poke: Dread Nova, Ether Crystal and long-range Infinite Obliteration beams all add a lingering burn on heroes, and Mind Rot adds bonus damage to it.
carry.issue: overconfident opener ('Argus wins with') the SOURCE does not support
carry.rewrite: Dread Nova, Ether Crystal and long-range Infinite Obliteration beams all add a lingering burn on heroes, and Mind Rot adds bonus damage to it.

carry.quote: Casting Dread Nova and Ether Crystal on cooldown stacks mana regen and earns gold from hero damage; Philosopher adds passive gold so your item spikes arrive on time.
carry.rewrite: Casting Dread Nova and Ether Crystal on cooldown stacks mana regen and earns gold from hero damage; Philosopher adds passive gold so you finish items sooner.

midlane.quote: Healing from your damage keeps you alive in Reckoning duels; Roses adds gold per takedown, stacking with Spectral Bounty's extra kill gold to snowball mid lane.
midlane.rewrite: Healing from your damage keeps you alive in Reckoning duels; Roses adds gold per takedown, stacking with Spectral Bounty's extra kill gold to pull ahead in mid lane.

offlane.quote: Harvest Nettles stacks on the same target and Untamed Growth burns over time; Vesh adds a lingering burn to each hit, rewarding steady poke over all-ins.
offlane.rewrite: Harvest Nettles stacks on the same target and Untamed Growth burns over time; Vesh adds a lingering burn to each hit, rewarding steady poke over risky full engages.

carry.quote: Assault Mode's long range lets you collect takedowns safely for Fearless stacks; you lose health, so stay at max range and let GTFO finish runners.
carry.issue: misleading: Satariel lowers max health, it does not drain health
carry.rewrite: Assault Mode's long range lets you collect takedowns safely for Fearless stacks; your max health drops, so stay at max range and let GTFO finish runners.

jungle.quote: Extra health makes Imperial Lash dives safer; Predator grants damage and speed after camp kills, so gank right after clearing.
jungle.issue: misdescribes Predator: only Camp Leader kills trigger it, not any camp
jungle.rewrite: Extra health makes Imperial Lash dives safer; Predator grants damage and speed after Camp Leader kills, so gank right after taking one.

offlane.quote: Damage climbs with every minion killed, so last-hit steadily and clear waves with Hamstring. Furor helps extended Windwalker trades once a fight starts.
offlane.issue: misdescribes Furor: it is a 4s burst on entering hero combat, not an extended-trade bonus
offlane.rewrite: Damage climbs with every minion killed, so last-hit steadily and clear waves with Hamstring. Furor speeds your first Windwalker hits when a trade starts.

carry.quote: Three quick Starfire hits on one hero deal max-health damage, which Hypercharge's rapid attacks reach easily. Melting Point helps against armored front-liners.
carry.issue: unsupported interaction: Hypercharge applies on-hit effects at only 10% effectiveness, so 'reach easily' overclaims Vermis during it
carry.rewrite: Every third quick Starfire hit on one hero deals max-health damage, so stay on one target between Hypercharge windows. Melting Point helps against armored front-liners.

midlane.quote: Three quick Starfire hits on one hero deal max-health damage, which Hypercharge's rapid attacks reach easily. Melting Point helps against armored front-liners.
midlane.issue: unsupported interaction: Hypercharge applies on-hit effects at only 10% effectiveness, so 'reach easily' overclaims Vermis during it
midlane.rewrite: Every third quick Starfire hit on one hero deals max-health damage, so stay on one target between Hypercharge windows. Melting Point helps against armored front-liners.

offlane.quote: Three quick Starfire hits on one hero deal max-health damage, which Hypercharge's rapid attacks reach easily. Melting Point helps against armored front-liners.
offlane.issue: unsupported interaction: Hypercharge applies on-hit effects at only 10% effectiveness, so 'reach easily' overclaims Vermis during it
offlane.rewrite: Every third quick Starfire hit on one hero deals max-health damage, so stay on one target between Hypercharge windows. Melting Point helps against armored front-liners.

support.quote: Three quick Starfire hits on one hero deal max-health damage during Hypercharge. Breach cuts armor after Atomiser lands, helping your carry follow up.
support.issue: unsupported interaction: Hypercharge applies on-hit effects at only 10% effectiveness, so tying Vermis to Hypercharge overclaims
support.rewrite: Every third quick Starfire hit on one hero deals max-health damage, so stay on one target. Breach cuts armor after Atomiser lands, helping your carry follow up.

support.quote: More health lets Terra start fights with Wild Rush and soak focus; Regenerative Tissue refills you between skirmishes, so step back briefly instead of recalling.
support.issue: overclaim: Regenerative Tissue is a slow regen after 8s out of hero damage; advising it over recalling is misleading
support.rewrite: More health lets Terra start fights with Wild Rush and soak focus; Regenerative Tissue slowly heals you after 8s without hero damage, so disengage briefly between skirmishes.

midlane.quote: Xyris rewards farming, and Knock, Knock! deals extra damage to minions, so clear waves from range with Sniper's Bounty gold; Eviscerate helps open on healthy targets.
midlane.issue: overclaim: Knock, Knock! hits only the first unit, so it secures last hits rather than clearing waves
midlane.rewrite: Xyris grows with every unit killed; Knock, Knock! hits minions harder, so use it for ranged last hits and Sniper's Bounty gold. Eviscerate helps open on healthy targets.

support.quote: Spark attacks and every Tesla Dome hit add Rust, weakening enemy armor for your carry while you gain some of it back.
support.issue: 'gain some of it back' misdescribes Knell: you gain armor from what you shred, nothing is returned
support.rewrite: Spark attacks and Tesla Dome hits add Rust, weakening enemy armor for your carry while you gain armor from what you shred.

jungle.quote: Gank often with Skull Crusher and Kingslayer to collect Lotus stacks from takedowns; Betrayer's Reqiuem shortens Kingslayer so you can fight more often.
jungle.issue: augment lowers Kingslayer's cooldown; 'shortens Kingslayer' reads as a shorter ability
jungle.rewrite: Gank often with Skull Crusher and Kingslayer to collect Lotus bonuses from takedowns; Betrayer's Reqiuem lowers Kingslayer's cooldown so you can fight more often.

carry.quote: Masterpiece stacks on kills, so after a takedown keep firing to hold Helios Core heat and push into Limit Break rather than resetting.
carry.issue: Masterpiece triggers on kills only, not any takedown (assists do not stack it)
carry.rewrite: Masterpiece stacks on kills, so after securing one keep firing to hold Helios Core heat and push into Limit Break rather than resetting.

jungle.quote: Gank often to collect Lotus stacks from takedowns; Masterpiece adds damage and speed after kills, so push straight into the next fight with Limit Break.
jungle.issue: implies Limit Break is ready on demand; it needs Helios Core to Overheat first
jungle.rewrite: Gank often to collect Lotus bonuses from takedowns; Masterpiece adds damage and speed after kills, so keep hitting heroes to build Helios Core heat toward Limit Break.

offlane.quote: Flawless heals you on each Hive or Swarm hit on heroes, and Fragrance boosts magical damage up close while Swarm runs through them.
offlane.issue: Flawless heals once per cast, not on each hero a Swarm passes through
offlane.rewrite: Flawless heals you once per Hive or Swarm cast that hits a hero, and Fragrance boosts magical damage up close while Swarm runs through them.

support.quote: Eclipse dives create takedowns that roll extra bonuses over time; with Flawless, every Contagion or Beguile hit on a hero also heals your carry beside you.
support.issue: Flawless heals once per cast, not on every Contagion tick
support.rewrite: Eclipse dives create takedowns that roll extra bonuses; with Flawless, each Contagion or Beguile cast that hits a hero heals you and your carry beside you.

carry.quote: A Pulse Bolt carry leans on item stats, which this boosts; Bio-Mechanical Fusion turns magical power for Energy Lance into extra physical power.
carry.issue: Bio-Mechanical Fusion adds physical power from magical power; it does not convert it away
carry.rewrite: A Pulse Bolt carry leans on item stats, which this boosts; Bio-Mechanical Fusion adds physical power from the magical power you build for Energy Lance.

midlane.quote: Long-range Longshot pokes on heroes turn damage into gold and mana regen; Runic Focus rewards staying high on mana before your Maco Sparkle! burst.
midlane.issue: Aion's mana regen comes from casting, not from damage dealt
midlane.rewrite: Every cast builds Aion mana regen, and long-range Longshot pokes on heroes earn gold; Runic Focus rewards staying high on mana before your Maco Sparkle! burst.

jungle.quote: Ruyi Jingu Bang hits on low-health heroes fire missiles through walls; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after Somersault or your dashes.
jungle.issue: Somersault is a double jump; SOURCE does not support it triggering Wind-Rider (dash, leap, teleport, stealth)
jungle.rewrite: Ruyi Jingu Bang hits on low-health heroes fire missiles through walls; Wind-Rider adds attack speed after a Windsurge dash or Pole Vault leap.

offlane.quote: Cannon hits on low-health heroes fire missiles through walls; Sniper Shells attack speed adds more of them.
offlane.issue: overclaim: extra missiles need 30% bonus attack speed, which Sniper Shells' 4% stacks (max 5) cannot reach alone
offlane.rewrite: Cannon hits on low-health heroes fire missiles through walls; Sniper Shells attack speed, stacked with attack speed items, can add extra missiles.

carry.quote: Cannon hits on low-health heroes fire missiles through walls; Sniper Shells attack speed adds missiles to finish fleeing targets.
carry.issue: overclaim: extra missiles need 30% bonus attack speed, which Sniper Shells' 4% stacks (max 5) cannot reach alone
carry.rewrite: Cannon hits on low-health heroes fire missiles through walls; with attack speed items, Sniper Shells stacks can add extra missiles to finish fleeing targets.
